scope: source provenance and historical address coverage; generated vendor-derived auth data is included as C source; no private account/session bytes

coreadi.runtime: anonymous MID/OTP from existing adi.pb and Android ID

mescal.runtime: SAP signing and native GUID field derivation

source_fps_pipeline.runtime: source SPC/FPS session and CKC experimentation; online content-key derivation is not verified

wrapper_kg_integrity_fold.scope: static call sites inside historical reference basic-block coverage; not source branch telemetry

wrapper_kg_ckc_integrity_word.scope: static call sites inside historical reference basic-block coverage; not source branch telemetry

fill_dispatch.scope: pristine byte-fill branch destinations only; not a crypto integrity replacement
fill_dispatch.derivation: prefix/bulk/suffix store counts and source control-label spacing

integrity_codec_simd.scope: pristine arithmetic SIMD data; parameterized codec recovered, fold/pair banks unresolved
integrity_codec_simd.derivation: SIMD lane indices, byte masks, FNV multiplier and modular inverse

registry_generations.scope: canonical generation allocation and pre-codec tag check only; no complete encoded-record registry/session replacement

copy_codecs.scope: two output-byte arithmetic stages and their bounded forward-copy transforms/inverses; no surrounding cipher or packet validation
copy_codecs.derivation: explicit unsigned arithmetic from original instructions; no image words, lookup tables or fitted cryptographic encoding parameters
copy_codecs.stage0_state: low BL starts at 0xd0, is saved/restored at frame -0x78, and advances by two while index advances by one; only bits 2 and 3 affect output
copy_codecs.stage1_state: low R13 byte starts at zero and advances by two while the index advances by one
